L1.name: Remembering
L1.aicte_descriptor: Recalling from the memory of the previously learned material
templates_short: {verb} the fundamental principles and characteristics of {topic}.
{verb} the primary components and terminology associated with {topic}.
{verb} any four key properties or architectural elements of {topic}.
{verb} the formal definition and standard representation of {topic}.
Define the term {topic} and {verb} its primary operational significance.
{verb} the distinct categories or types into which {topic} is classified.
templates_medium: {verb} {topic} and list its essential building blocks along with their individual functions.
{verb} the fundamental rules, mathematical formulas, or axioms associated with {topic}.
{verb} the sequence of operational phases involved in {topic}.
{verb} the primary advantages, features, and known limitations of using {topic}.

L2.name: Understanding
templates_short: {verb} the working mechanism of {topic} with a suitable illustrative example or diagram.
{verb} how {topic} operates and explain why it is essential in modern computing.
{verb} the variants and classifications of {topic}, highlighting their distinctive features.
{verb} the main principles and conceptual foundations that govern {topic}.
templates_medium: {verb} in detail the architecture and step-by-step workflow of {topic} with a neat schematic sketch.
{verb} the behavior of {topic} against conventional baseline techniques with respect to efficiency and complexity.
{verb} the internal mechanism of {topic}. How does it handle edge conditions or boundary inputs?
{verb} the structural organization of {topic} and trace how information flows across its different layers.
{verb} the concept of {topic} using a real-world scenario (such as e-commerce, banking, or cloud services).

L3.name: Applying
L3.aicte_descriptor: Using the information in another familiar situation
templates_medium: {verb} the principles of {topic} to solve the computational problem for the given dataset: {parameters}. Show all intermediate steps.
{verb} the step-by-step execution of {topic} for: {parameters}. Trace the resultant state transitions.
{verb} the expected output and execution cost when {topic} is applied to a workload with {parameters}.
{verb} a formal procedure or algorithm to implement {topic} for an application requiring high throughput.
{verb} the resultant outcome when {topic} processes an input sequence of {parameters}. Provide clear justification for each transition.
templates_long: A software system experiences high latency under heavy concurrency. {verb} the mechanics of {topic} to resolve this bottleneck. Show step-by-step computation, state transitions, and the final stabilized configuration.

Given the problem specification with parameters: {parameters}, {verb} a rigorous mathematical or algorithmic solution employing {topic}. Provide the step-by-step trace table and quantify final performance.
{verb} the complete logical workflow for {topic} assuming input constraints: {parameters}. Verify your solution with a dry run on boundary test cases.

L4.name: Analyzing
L4.aicte_descriptor: Breaking information into the part to explore understandings and relationships
templates_medium: {verb} the asymptotic time and space trade-offs in {topic} when scaled to massive workloads.
{verb} thoroughly between {topic} and rival paradigms across latency, storage overhead, and fault resilience.
{verb} the operational stages of {topic} and analyze where critical bottlenecks or race conditions are most likely to emerge.
{verb} the impact of parameter variations on the stability, accuracy, and correctness of {topic}.
templates_long: {verb} the internal trade-offs of {topic} under varying workload densities: {scenario}. Quantify resource utilization, worst-case complexity, and provide analytical proof supporting your findings.

{verb} a critical failure scenario in a production cluster utilizing {topic}. Deconstruct the root causes, analyze the failure propagation path, and establish the structural weaknesses that triggered the breakdown.
{verb} the behavior of {topic} with respect to consistency versus availability. How does altering the underlying parameters influence operational throughput under peak loads?

L5.name: Evaluating
L5.aicte_descriptor: Justifying a decision or course of action
templates_medium: {verb} the standard implementation of {topic}. Identify its major vulnerabilities and justify possible remedial measures.
{verb} whether an enterprise engineering team should adopt or reject {topic} for mission-critical real-time processing in {scenario}.
{verb} the performance metrics of {topic} based on benchmark criteria including throughput, latency, precision, and reliability.
{verb} the trade-offs between computational overhead and security guarantees in {topic}.
templates_long: An organization is modernizing its mission-critical infrastructure ({scenario}). Two alternative architectures are proposed, one centered on {topic} and another on baseline protocols. {verb} both options across scalability, fault tolerance, maintenance cost, and compliance, providing a definitive justified recommendation.

{verb} the resilience of {topic} under adversarial conditions and high-concurrency stress. Formulate an empirical assessment framework and defend whether the system meets strict SLA targets (99.99% uptime).
{verb} the theoretical limitations of {topic}. Justify with quantitative arguments why certain industry benchmarks fail to reflect real-world execution costs.

L6.name: Creating
L6.aicte_descriptor: Generating new ideas, products or new ways of viewing things
templates_medium: {verb} a robust modular architecture utilizing {topic} that guarantees high availability and zero data loss in {scenario}.
{verb} a novel algorithmic strategy or workflow incorporating {topic} to optimize resource allocation in distributed networks.
{verb} an end-to-end framework integrating {topic} into a modern microservices ecosystem with automated failover.
{verb} a comprehensive testing and validation scheme to verify the behavioral integrity of a system based on {topic}.
templates_long: You are the chief systems architect tasked with designing a next-generation platform for {scenario}. {verb} a comprehensive system blueprint that leverages {topic}. Your proposal must detail the schema/component design, inter-module communication protocols, fault-tolerance mechanisms, data consistency guarantees, and scalability roadmap.

{verb} and synthesize an innovative hybrid model combining {topic} with intelligent predictive caching. Provide the complete architectural schematic, component interfaces, state transition equations, and deployment topology.
{verb} an original algorithmic blueprint that enhances {topic} to operate efficiently under constrained edge-computing environments with strict energy and bandwidth limitations.

scenarios: a high-frequency algorithmic financial exchange processing 500,000 transactions/second
a distributed patient monitoring telemetry system in an intensive healthcare network
an autonomous fleet logistics and route optimization platform managing 50,000 delivery vehicles
a planetary-scale video streaming content delivery network (CDN) during peak broadcast events
a mission-critical aerospace avionics telemetry and real-time flight control subsystem
a decentralized smart-meter electrical grid managing renewable energy load balancing
a zero-trust banking authentication gateway handling federated multi-factor transactions
a global e-commerce inventory engine with real-time flash-sale concurrency management
an intelligent predictive clinical diagnostic pipeline for multi-class pathology screening
an automated credit fraud risk classification engine trained on imbalanced transactional streams
parameter_samples: Input size N = 10^6, cache block size = 64 bytes, and associative degree k = 4
Relation R(A, B, C, D, E) with Functional Dependencies F = {A->BC, CD->E, B->D, E->A}
Weights W = {2, 3, 4, 5, 9} and Values V = {3, 4, 5, 8, 10} with knapsack capacity C = 15
Graph vertices V = {v1, v2, v3, v4, v5} with directed weighted edge matrix and cost bounds
Transaction schedule S1: R1(A), R2(B), W1(A), R2(A), W2(B), Commit1, Commit2
Training dataset with 10 features, 5% class imbalance, and 100,000 observations
Contingency matrix with 120 total samples: TP=60, TN=100, actual positives=80, actual negatives=120
Samples I (N=9, Mean=68, SS=36) and Sample II (N=9, Mean=69, SS=40) under significance level alpha=0.05
